symptoms: Altered consciousness, lethargy, irritability, seizures, signs of dehydration

management_steps.details: Free water deficit = 0.6 x Weight(kg) x [(sNa - 140)/140]. Infuse 5% Dextrose Water or 0.45% Saline. Correct serum Na+ by max 10-12 mmol/l in 24 hours (<= 0.5 mmol/l/hr).

warnings: Do NOT correct serum Sodium faster than 0.5 mmol/l/hr to prevent cerebral oedema.
